d:
Dean Curnutt, founder and CEO of Macro Risk Advisors, says the market selloff could prove “cleansing” by resetting valuations and making room for fresh capital, but warns that the growing overlap between the AI trade and the broader economy could leave markets vulnerable to further downside. He also sees short-dated Treasuries as a haven if the Federal Reserve is forced to reverse course. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
